## 1. Review Scope

This review answers two distinct questions: the **source posture** of each
named vendor offering, and whether potentially usable **alternative
implementations** of the capability exist, whether or not a reviewed vendor
owns them. Repository visibility does not establish that a vendor product
is open-source, and an SDK, connector, benchmark, or documentation
repository is never reported as the product core.
